data.title: 吹雪 · 咖啡馆里的行程空白
data.description: 吹雪穿黑白格纹西装和米白阔腿裤，坐在咖啡馆角落把日程本翻到空白的一页。她将笔平放在杯碟边，双手捧住咖啡，望向窗外时肩膀终于松了一点，像认真给自己留出一个下午。
data.action: 合上日程本放下笔，双手捧咖啡看向窗外。
data.promptProse: Fubuki turns her schedule book to an empty page in the cafe corner, lays the pen beside the saucer and cradles coffee with both hands. Her checked blazer, forest-green blouse and cream wide-leg trousers relax as she looks outside. The medium portrait includes the window-side table and quiet seating behind. Soft cafe daylight illuminates pearls and cup steam, with restrained shadows beneath the saucer and across the open planner.
